crowbar.config.title: CrowBar
crowbar.config.nametags.tooltip: Show player and claim names above their markers.
crowbar.config.skins.tooltip: Draw player faces over their markers.
crowbar.config.show_distance.tooltip: Show how many blocks away each marker is.
crowbar.config.view_self.tooltip: Show only your own marker on a clean bar, for screenshots. Hides hearts, hunger and armor. Turns off when you restart.
crowbar.config.height_arrows.tooltip: Show an arrow above or below a marker when the target is far above or below you.
crowbar.config.server_appearance.tooltip: Let servers running the CrowBar plugin choose some appearance settings while you play there. Settings a server chooses are greyed out here, and yours come back when you leave.
crowbar.config.server_locked.tooltip: This server chooses this setting. Turn off Server appearance on the General tab to use your own.
crowbar.config.label_background.tooltip: Draw a dark plate behind each label so it stays readable over bright terrain.
crowbar.config.raise_hud.tooltip: Smoothly lift hearts, hunger, the experience level and chat above the labels while any label is showing.
crowbar.config.dim_labels.tooltip: Draw every label except the one nearest your crosshair at reduced opacity.
crowbar.config.hide_overlapping.tooltip: Skip labels that would overlap one nearer your crosshair.
crowbar.config.skin_border.tooltip: Draw faces inside a frame in the player's dot color, so team colors stay visible with skins on.
crowbar.config.fade_markers.tooltip: Fade markers out as targets get farther away, between 100 and 1000 blocks by default. The range is set in config/crowbar.json. On servers that don't send CrowBar player positions, Minecraft 1.21.6 and newer draw the dots themselves, so only faces and labels fade there.
crowbar.config.dot_colors.tooltip: Team: the player's team color, or a color unique to them. Per player: ignore teams. Single color: everyone uses the color below.
crowbar.config.custom_color.tooltip: Color of every player dot when Dot colors is set to Single color. Any #RRGGBB value can be set in config/crowbar.json.
crowbar.config.self_color.tooltip: Color of your own marker in view-self mode. Automatic follows the same rules as everyone else's dot. Other players' screens are not affected.
crowbar.config.self_color.tooltip.server: Color of your own marker in view-self mode. This server also shows your dot to other CrowBar players in this color. Automatic leaves the color up to the server.
crowbar.config.key_mode.tooltip: Toggle: each press turns the feature on or off. Hold: the feature shows only while you hold the key.
